name: Lugus
source:
‘I won’t allow you to get in my way anymore than you already have. Now scram.’ 

Son of the Hawk family’s leader. Due to his cold expression and how intense he is, many find it difficult to approach him. He deeply respects his father, Olgar, and assists him in his work. Though he is a leader to the young men in Hawk, he keeps his distance and mostly works on his own.

[From [url=https://sakura52-blog.tumblr.com/post/174361157222/psychedelica-of-the-ashen-hawk-character-profiles]Sakura52's blog[/url]]
